autedium_grindfulness.config.title: AuTedium - Grindfulness
Sneak-break an ore or log to break the whole connected vein/tree. Pays full durability and hunger per block — same cost, less clicking.
Consecutive breaks of the same block family build Haste I→III. Stop or switch and it fades. Faster, not cheaper.
autedium_grindfulness.module.pity_ping.d: Long diamond dry streak while deep mining? The nearest existing vein glows briefly. Never spawns ore — reveal only.
Sneak + right-click with a pickaxe: nearby ores glow for 5s. 45s cooldown. The spiciest toggle here.
autedium_grindfulness.module.toasts.desc: Milestone popups and dry-streak progress. Pure feedback, zero balance impact.
